استكرهتا (form X)
# اِسْتَكْرَهَتَا (istakrahatā) /is.tak.ra.ha.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
# اُسْتُكْرِهَتَا (ustukrihatā) /us.tuk.ri.ha.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
